full_judgment:
7. By the judgment and order dated 23-8-82 the learned Munsif allowed the said Misc. Case holding inter alia, that the case is bad for defect of parties but such non-joinder of parties is not fatal in the case. The opposite party Nos. 9-12 of the original Misc. Case did not transpose themselves into the position of co-petitioners in the case and, as such they are not entitled to pre-empt the case land. 

 23. Therefore in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the light of my above discussion I hold that the discretion conferred by section 153 should be exercised and also extension of time granted under section 5 of the Limitation Act although no separate application under section 5 of the Limitation Act has been filed but the reasons for non-impleading the heirs of deceased respondent Abdul Hashim who are already on record in the original Misc. case have been explained in the petition itself.
